description:
One wallet's sports and esports markets, the rows behind the profile positions table. status=closed (the default) is the Closed tab: no live leg, or the market has a winner, or the open row's cost is under 0.10 USD. status=open is the Open tab: a live leg whose cost is at least 0.10 USD and that has no winner. status=all is both, newest last trade first, not open rows before closed rows. An open row with no winner and no stored cost is in all only. cost and realized_pnl are the stored total_cost_num and realized_pnl_num the profile labels Cost and Realized, each an exact decimal with value, unit USD, scale and basis; null means not stored, never zero. resolved_at is markets.resolved_at and is null when the market has not settled, including a closed position on a market that still trades. Ordered by last_trade_at descending, then condition_id descending; a row with no last_trade_at comes after every dated row. The cursor is bound to the same status. GET /api/v1/positions stays the open board and still leaves resolved markets out.

Args:
  - address (string, required): Wallet address (0x...), username, or trd_-prefixed trader id
  - status (string, optional): open, closed (default) or all
  - limit (integer, optional): Markets per page, 1-100, default 20
  - cursor (string, optional): next_cursor from the previous page, bound to the same status

Returns: data, has_more, next_cursor and meta.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...), username, or trd_-prefixed trader id

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; it is bound to the same status

status.description: open, closed (default) or all. closed is the profile Closed tab. all is one time order, newest last trade first, not open rows before closed rows

name: get_trader_markets
